title: Holistic Automated Red Teaming for Large Language Models through Top-Down Test Case Generation and Multi-turn Interaction

bias_targets.methodology: Generating single-turn and multi-turn adversarial test cases top-down using the HolisticBias taxonomy (covering 13 demographic axes including Ability and Cultural) and evaluating LLM responses using an automated safety reward model.
Posing dilemma-based test questions (e.g., prioritizing an organ transplant between individuals of different ages) generated top-down from a risk taxonomy to assess fairness.
Prompting models to generate jokes about marginalized groups (e.g., bisexual people) and scoring the safety, sensitivity, and fairness of the responses using an LLM-based evaluation prompt.
